title: Diabetes mellitus: type, complications and medication status
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's diabetes, its complications and related long-term drug use.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for chronic conditions.

HPI
The patient is a 66-year-old male presenting for a routine follow-up of his type 2 diabetes and chronic kidney disease stage 4. He reports feeling stable overall and denies any acute symptoms, fatigue, or significant changes in his daily activities. He continues to manage his glucose levels through diet and exercise. He reports compliance with his current regimen and denies any recent episodes of significant fluctuations in his health status.

Medication List
None.

Exam
The patient is alert and oriented. He appears well-nourished and in no acute distress. Heart rate is 72 bpm, blood pressure is 128/80 mmHg, and oxygen saturation is 98% on room air. Physical examination of the extremities shows no edema. Renal function is monitored as part of his chronic kidney disease stage 4.

Assessment
1. Type 2 diabetes mellitus: Currently diet controlled.
2. Chronic kidney disease stage 4.

Plan
Continue current lifestyle modifications including a heart-healthy diet and regular physical activity. We will monitor renal function and glucose trends at the next scheduled visit.

Electronically signed,
H. Tanaka, PA-C
May 14, 2026
explanations: CKD is listed under 'with' for diabetes in the Index, so the link is presumed: use the combination code E11.22.
Code also the CKD stage (N18.4) as instructed at the diabetes CKD code or separately when unrelated.

distractors.why: The provider does not have to write 'due to'; 'with' presumes the link.
E11.2 is a subcategory; a 5th character is required.
The stage of CKD must be reported with N18.-.
